# ctables/as

> Conversion: `x as T`. To `u8` keeps the low byte, to `bool` tests for non-zero.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/as.pkg) · translates [std/as](../std/as.md)

  Other conversions keep the word.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when t u8`

```nasm
((W)(B)(
{v}
))
```

### `emit when t bool`

```nasm
((W)((
{v}
) != 0))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{v}
```
